department: Environmental Science PhD (Department of Biological Sciences)

deadline.value: The environmental science program's fall deadline is January 15 for financial support purposes.
deadline.quote: The environmental science graduate program application deadlines are: | Fall term/semester January 15

gre_general.value: The GRE is required for the PhD in the same departmental criteria as biology.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores (verbal, quantitative, and analytical writing sections) is required

gre_subject.value: The subject GRE is for diagnostic purposes and is not required for admission.
gre_subject.quote: The appropriate GRE subject test is also required for diagnostic purposes, but not for admission

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to be the applicant's major professor before admission.
supervisor.quote: Agreement by a faculty member to serve as the applicant’s major professor (i.e. advisor) is required for programs in biology, biochemistry and molecular biology, and environmental science

funding.value: The page ties funding to deadlines but does not say most students are funded.

entry_route.value: The bachelor's must include specified life-science, chemistry and math courses.
entry_route.quote: For the environmental science program, the bachelor’s degree must include a B or better in at least 6 credit hours of a life science

notes: The environmental science PhD has a Geoscience concentration, so earth is listed as also_fields. Same archived departmental page as the biology record.
